header.title: Bridging Code and Visual Geometry.
header.manifesto: Operating at the exact intersection of technical architecture and high-end visual design. My workflow combines robust web development in Next.js and Python with advanced graphic execution and cutting-edge AI tools. Whether it is configuring a complex e-commerce ecosystem, deploying a sleek progressive web app, or executing studio product photography, the philosophy remains the same: strip away the clutter, avoid soft edges, and build digital experiences anchored in strict architectural geometry.
